strings.facility.waystone.name: Waystone
strings.facility.waystone.summary: A record of the promises Everstead has kept and the milestones still ahead.
strings.facility.waystone.status.ready: A Legacy reward is ready to claim.
strings.facility.waystone.status.quiet: Your next Legacy milestones are still in progress.
strings.facility.waystone.claim.never-expires: Ready rewards remain here until you claim them.
strings.facility.waystone.claim.tracking-boundar: This record begins when Legacy tracking was activated on this save.
strings.facility.waystone.claim.lower-bound: Earlier history was incomplete. This record starts from the strongest value still visible in the save.
strings.legacy.track.oathkeeper.name: Oathkeeper
strings.legacy.track.oathkeeper.description: Complete Oaths after Legacy tracking begins. A valid scoped undo also removes that completion.
strings.legacy.track.unbroken.name: Unbroken
strings.legacy.track.unbroken.description: Raise the strongest observed Oath streak.
strings.legacy.track.steward.name: Steward
strings.legacy.track.steward.description: Collect Gold produced by the Village. Reward claims do not count toward this record.
strings.legacy.track.builder.name: Builder
strings.legacy.track.builder.description: Raise the combined level of Everstead's four founding Buildings.
strings.legacy.track.roadwarden.name: Roadwarden
strings.legacy.track.roadwarden.description: Secure new Fellow Campaign stages for the first time.
strings.legacy.track.veteran.name: Veteran
strings.legacy.feat.first-campaign-clear.name: First Road Secured
strings.legacy.feat.first-campaign-clear.descrip: Clear a Fellow Campaign stage for the first time.
strings.legacy.feat.first-covenant.name: The First Covenant
strings.legacy.feat.player-rank-5.name: Covenant Rank
strings.legacy.feat.book1-fellows-joined.name: The Full Roadbound Company
strings.legacy.feat.book1-fellows-joined.descrip: Welcome every Fellow scheduled to join during the First Covenant.
strings.legacy.feat.exact-power-campaign-clear.d: Clear a Fellow Campaign stage with total owned-roster Power exactly equal to the recommendation.
strings.legacy.cache.founding.name: Founding Cache
strings.legacy.cache.founding.description: Three or more standard milestones can be claimed together. Every component remains individually verified.
strings.facility.restaurant.name: Restaurant
strings.facility.restaurant.summary: Prepare a small menu, read each guest's preference, and claim the result after service.
strings.facility.restaurant.status.locked: The western plaza has been discovered, but the Restaurant is not ready to open.
strings.facility.restaurant.status.empty: No customers are waiting. The next arrival is in {time}.
strings.facility.restaurant.status.full: The waiting list is full. It will not expire, but new arrivals pause until space opens.
strings.facility.restaurant.status.claim-ready: Service complete. Claim the result when you are ready.
strings.facility.restaurant.preparation.offline: A preparation you already started may finish while you are away. It is never served or claimed automatically.
strings.facility.restaurant.stock.local: Prepared servings stay in the Restaurant and are not a global currency.
strings.facility.restaurant.result.basic.descrip: The dish was valid and the guest was served. Reputation and mastery still progress.
strings.facility.restaurant.result.partial.descr: The dish met part of the guest's preference and earned a modest tip.
strings.facility.restaurant.result.matched.descr: The dish met the full preference and earned the strongest fixed tip for this service band.
strings.facility.restaurant.progress.local-only: Restaurant progression is local and does not replace passive Building levels.
strings.restaurant.recipe.hearth-stew.name: Hearth Stew
strings.restaurant.recipe.hearth-stew.descriptio: A warming, hearty bowl prepared at the Hearth station.
strings.restaurant.recipe.garden-flatbread.name: Garden Flatbread
strings.restaurant.recipe.garden-flatbread.descr: A quick, portable meal prepared at either initial station.
strings.restaurant.recipe.roadside-tea.name: Roadside Tea
strings.restaurant.recipe.roadside-tea.descripti: A light, fresh drink prepared at the Prep Table.
strings.restaurant.station.hearth.name: Hearth Station
strings.restaurant.station.hearth.description: The opening station for stew and simple flatbread batches.
strings.restaurant.station.prep-table.name: Prep Table
strings.restaurant.station.prep-table.descriptio: Unlocks with Reputation Level 2 for flatbread and tea preparation.
strings.restaurant.customer.road-worker.name: Road Worker
strings.restaurant.customer.road-worker.descript: Usually asks for something warming or quick before returning to the road.
strings.restaurant.customer.archive-courier.name: Archive Courier
strings.restaurant.customer.archive-courier.desc: Usually asks for something quick or light between deliveries.
strings.restaurant.customer.route-envoy.name: Route Envoy
strings.restaurant.customer.route-envoy.descript: A one-time named visitor connected to the opening road story.
strings.restaurant.preference.warming.name: Warming
strings.restaurant.preference.quick.name: Quick
strings.restaurant.preference.light.name: Light
strings.restaurant.visitor.route-envoy.ready: A route envoy has arrived and will wait until served.
strings.restaurant.visitor.route-envoy.claimed: The route envoy's visit has been recorded in the Chronicle.
strings.tutorial.facility.board.discover-hotspot: Buildings are opened from their real places in the Village picture.
A dim icon is discovered but locked. A clear icon is available. A glow means an activity or claim is ready.
Tap an icon to see its activity, progress, and waiting claims.
strings.tutorial.legacy.tracks.first-progress.tr: Legacy tracks record continuing work from a verified starting point.
strings.tutorial.legacy.tracks.first-progress.ti: Each visible milestone shows the exact progress still needed.
strings.tutorial.legacy.tracks.first-progress.re: You can inspect the full reward before it becomes ready.
strings.tutorial.legacy.tracks.first-progress.co: Claiming a milestone records it permanently; later tiers can continue the same track.
strings.tutorial.legacy.claim.first-ready.ready-: The Waystone shows how many verified Legacy rewards are ready.
strings.tutorial.legacy.claim.first-ready.manual: Rewards are credited only when you press Claim.
strings.tutorial.legacy.claim.first-ready.never-: A ready Legacy reward never expires.
strings.tutorial.legacy.claim.first-ready.next-t: The next tier is evaluated only after this claim is safely recorded.
strings.tutorial.legacy.claim.major.major-reveal: Major feats stay separate so their reward and history are easy to review.
strings.tutorial.legacy.claim.major.accelerate: Major rewards accelerate progress; they do not replace passive Village production.
strings.tutorial.legacy.claim.major.history: Once claimed, the feat remains in permanent Legacy history.
strings.tutorial.legacy.feats.first-feat.one-tim: A feat is a one-time verified accomplishment.
strings.tutorial.legacy.feats.first-feat.claim: The feat's reward still requires a manual claim.
strings.tutorial.legacy.feats.first-feat.chronic: The claimed feat remains visible in Legacy and the Chronicle.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.first-customer.custo: Each waiting card is one guest. Guests stay in the queue until you serve them.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.first-customer.prefe: Read the preference before choosing a dish.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.first-customer.choos: Choose an unlocked recipe and a compatible station with prepared stock.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.first-customer.serve: Serving creates a result to review. It does not credit the reward yet.
Facility opportunities collect while there is room in the local queue.
At capacity, new arrivals pause without creating hidden debt.
Banked opportunities do not expire or reset at midnight.
Passive Village production continues whether or not you use the facility.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.first-claim.sales: The sale is a fixed Gold amount from the service's captured Village-production band.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.first-claim.tips: A better preference match adds a fixed tip, never a permanent multiplier.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.first-claim.reputati: Every valid service adds local Reputation and Recipe Mastery.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.first-claim.claim: Press Claim to credit the Gold and progress exactly once.
strings.tutorial.facility.claim.first-ready.resu: A resolved activity waits as a claim-ready result.
strings.tutorial.facility.claim.first-ready.clai: Only an explicit claim applies its rewards.
strings.tutorial.facility.claim.first-ready.loca: The same verified claim applies its approved local progress.
strings.tutorial.facility.claim.first-ready.rece: A permanent receipt prevents the result from paying twice.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.recipes-and-stations: Serving a recipe raises its local Mastery.
Stations decide which recipes can be prepared at the same time.
Prepared servings stay in the Restaurant and never expire.
The next Reputation level previews its recipe or station before it unlocks.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.reputation.reputatio: Reputation Level 3 completes the first Restaurant progression slice.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.reputation.unlock-pr: Later levels can add content through new versioned definitions without changing saved customers.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.reputation.local-onl: Reputation changes this Restaurant only. It does not alter passive Building production.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.named-visitors.named: A named visitor is an authored, one-time customer opportunity.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.named-visitors.story: The visit can add a Chronicle entry only after its claim commits.
strings.tutorial.restaurant.named-visitors.banke: The visitor does not expire and will wait until served.
strings.dialogue.waystone.lyra.objective-guide.l: The Waystone keeps our promises in one place. Start with the next one we can honestly keep.
This mark belongs to everyone who carried the work. Claim it when you are ready to record it.
Each track names its source. If the old record is incomplete, the Waystone says so instead of pretending.
A clean record is useful because it remembers both what happened and where the count began.
strings.dialogue.legacy.syl.claim-guide.line.01: Nothing ready here will vanish. Look over the reward, then claim it when it suits you.
strings.dialogue.waystone.syl.claim-acknowledgem: There. Kept, counted, and still part of the road ahead.
strings.dialogue.waystone.virginia.major-claim-c: A major claim should show its full value and its source. Celebration is clearer when the record is clear.
strings.dialogue.legacy.captain-america.first-fe: A feat records what held under pressure. Claim it, preserve the evidence, and keep moving.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.tifa.servic: Read the preference first. A small menu works when every dish has a clear purpose.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.tifa.claim-: Service is finished. Check the sale, tip, and progress before you claim them.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.tamsin.bank: Customers will wait, but the room has limits. When the list is full, arrivals pause until we make space.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.tamsin.ambi: The shelves are counted, the Hearth is warm, and nobody's plate is disappearing at midnight.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.jaina.named: The roads are carrying news again. Serve the envoy well, and the visit can become part of Everstead's record.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.jaina.reput: Reputation should open better work, not become another thing to spend. Keep it local and readable.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.deadpool.na: I heard there was a table open. I brought an appetite and very little useful route information.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.deadpool.re: Clear plate, fair price, no mystery. That is a successful field report.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.star-lord.n: A warm room and a reliable road are difficult to argue with. What travels well from here?
The tables fill quickly. I can carry dishes if someone keeps the walkway clear.
strings.dialogue.facility.restaurant.misty.ambie: Travelers talk while they wait. Half the work is noticing which road their stories came from.
